title: Bills of Lading and Transport Documents: service contract tier ranks used for the telex release fee
content:
## Scope

When the Bills of Lading and Transport Documents telex release fee is assessed, a service contract tier is expressed as a rank. The rank of each contract tier is the rank the service contract charter gives it, as listed below.

## Rank card

| Service contract tier | Contract tier rank |
|---|---|
| AHL Starter Service Contract | 1 |
| AHL Standard Service Contract | 2 |
| AHL Regional Account Contract | 3 |
| AHL Key Account Contract | 4 |
| AHL Global Account Contract | 5 |
| AHL Strategic Partner Contract | 6 |

## Reading the card

- The ranks run in ascending order from the AHL Starter Service Contract at 1 to the AHL Strategic Partner Contract at 6; a higher number is a higher contract tier.
- Each contract tier has exactly one rank.

**What rank does an AHL Key Account Contract carry?** Rank 4.

**Which contract tier ranks directly above the AHL Regional Account Contract?** The AHL Key Account Contract, at rank 4 against rank 3.
